scope: Offline exact Gen7 preallocated owner/type gaps and independent supplied AO scalar classifier only.

preallocated_findings: get_mem_alloc_entry excludes HW_FENCE from ordinary GMU-only allocation even without GFX_ACC. MEMSTORE uses the preallocated switch only in the GPU-access branch. Returned entry sizes/addresses come from existing descriptors, not request-sized fresh generic CPU allocation.

HW-fence registration requires feature support, context queues and no existing enabled flag. External registration supplies its descriptor. KGSL assigns device_addr to its physaddr field and uses external size/virtual_addr before SG setup; that assignment is not native PA/IOVA proof.

Registration is void; null/error client handle logs and returns unavailable. SG setup failure deregisters/clears the descriptor; successful setup creates the cache and sets the flag. Deregistration calls external deregister then frees SG/clears metadata/cache/flag without retaining a manager result in this function. No native success/release result is inferred.

An exact unsupported-feature branch passes opaque hw_fence.handle to adreno_hwsched_deregister_hw_fence, whose declared parameter and implementation require adreno_device*. The isolated one-line patch passes adreno_dev. It is unapplied; no phone fault or original Linux C compile failure is claimed. C++ port compile rejects the wrong void* owner type.

MEMSTORE allocation is device-global during adreno probe, with optional APRIV-derived privilege. Removal closes dispatcher then platform removal reaches kgsl_free_globals. The global-free implementation and actual native stop/DMA release conditions are still outside this bound contract.

KGSL plain UAPI record is40B with EOP offset8; current NativeRing CP timestamp goes to fence_iova+4. These layouts/providers are distinct; no existing native ring fence is imported as either full memstore or external HW_FENCE queue.

native_provider_gap.HW_FENCE: Requires actual msm_hw_fence_register(HW_FENCE_CLIENT_ID_CTX0,&mem_descriptor) client, external device_addr/size/virtual_addr and SG import. Public exact API/header and native Darwin provider not bound. Actual manager/device-address meaning, client/queue/ref/peer lifetime and deregistration result remain unavailable.
native_provider_gap.MEMSTORE: Device-global kgsl_allocate_global at adreno probe; size is Linux PAGE_SIZE*8, not8 XNU pages or a verified current fixed size. UAPI plain40B record has SOP0/EOP8; context/ring offsets depend on its own array. Actual kgsl_free_globals body/complete native release proof not bound.
native_provider_gap.native_comparison: NativeAdrenoRing/Submit provide CP timestamp/ring job completion, not the external HW-fence client/TxRx descriptor or complete per-context KGSL memstore. NativeGmuContext is legacy fixed-buffer source, not this provider.

result.independent_platform_progress: Implemented a real pure CPU classifier of supplied Gen7 GMU AO status, after binding source masks/handler. It preserves raw32, watchdog0/AHB-fence3/host-AHB5 and every unhandled bit including named RSCC1/DBD4. AHB-fence3 requests separate auxiliary status, never invents it. It neither reads/clears a register nor implements an IRQ handler, NMI, watchdog action, HW-fence/CP completion or ownership.
result.network_limits: Web cache/search had no content. Exact installed Linux include-path raw URL404 and actual pinned provider include listing did not bind the public msm_hw_fence API header; no unknown structure/prototype was invented.
limitations: Fully unattended, physical_assistance_available=false, no new device execution authorization. No phone/USB/native getter/allocator/provider/cache/IRQ callback/MMIO/ack/mask/NMI/SCM/PAS/power/clock/reset/SMMU/VM/IOVA/GPU invocation; no runtime caller/FD/kernel/device candidate.

HW_FENCE requires a real external client registration, descriptor and Tx/Rx peer lifetime. MEMSTORE is a device-global resource with context/ring records; neither native CP timestamp fence nor software fence/transport ACK substitutes. Native borrowed-resource adapter remains absent.

Public msm_hw_fence API header/selected kernel provider contract and Native Darwin counterpart are not bound. Do not invent its typedef/return type, treat device_addr as proven PA/IOVA, or supply a fake registered handle/queue/fence. Linux teardown is not native stop/release proof.

Only new HFI IRQ-domain source/status checks, no repeat preallocated4/C++port1/AOsource3/object2/native3 or prior composition/ledger/extent/HFI packet/CPU suites. Both old native repairs and new reference-owner patch remain unapplied; old profiles/capsules/default42 unchanged.

No query/HFI/272B/ZORNGQF1/normal-log field/fragment/carrier, EFI/Darwin pointer handoff or CPU policy expansion. Pure supplied-status classification is not native observation, IRQ_HANDLED, queue completion or ownership. allow_boot/readback/WriteAuthorized0.
